# Wan-Video Pilot — Comprehensive Architecture & Technical Specification

## Author
Engineer Abdullah Bin Zafar (Autonomous Systems & Embedded Software Engineer)

## Overview
Wan-Video Pilot is an open-source engineering toolkit designed to resolve critical community bottlenecks in Alibaba Cloud's Wan-Video generative video diffusion architecture.

## Mathematical Memory Foundations
The analytical memory required by Wan-Video DiT models is bounded by:
\[
Tokens = \left\lfloor\frac{H}{16}\right\rfloor \times \left\lfloor\frac{W}{16}\right\rfloor \times \left(1 + \left\lfloor\frac{F - 1}{4}\right\rfloor\right)
\]
For 720p (1280x720, 81 frames):
Tokens = 80 x 45 x 21 = 75,600 tokens.

In Wan2.2 MoE, concurrent residency of both experts leads to:
Total Params: ~27.0B
At fp8: 27.0 GB weights + 2.5 GB activations + 10.8 GB VAE (untiled) + 9.6 GB T5 = 53.6 GB (Crash on 24GB GPUs).
With sequential expert offload at t_moe:
Active Params: ~14.3B
At fp8: 13.3 GB active weights + 1.7 GB activations + 1.8 GB tiled VAE + 0.0 GB T5 (CPU) + 1.6 GB overhead = 18.47 GB Peak VRAM (Runs cleanly on RTX 4090 / 3090).

## Model Context Protocol (MCP) Interface
Exposes 5 standardized tools conforming to MCP 2024-11-05:
1. `diagnose_preflight`: Hardware & Attention verification.
2. `estimate_memory`: Analytical VRAM decomposition.
3. `validate_media_inputs`: EXIF transposition and codec checks.
4. `compile_workflow`: Multi-target code generation.
5. `execute_local_pipeline`: Safe dry-run execution.
